Strategy: Refine gated worst fit with a stricter gate and sliver penalty: use worst fit only when the item is at most a quarter of the loosest bin, otherwise Best Fit with a penalty for leftovers below item/4, plus an exact-fit bonus. The choice differs from Best Fit for small items with a loose bin, and when the sliver penalty flips two tight bins. The gate may protect tight bins, but it can rarely trigger.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) + (r if item * 4 <= max(bins) else -(r - item) - (30 if 0 < r - item < item / 4 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
